title: Roe v. Wade legalizes abortion in the United States
summary: The US Supreme Court ruled that the Constitution protected a woman's right to choose abortion.
reason: Abortion was banned in most states, and the case challenged a Texas law.
significance: It shaped American politics for half a century until it was overturned in 2022.
participants: Supreme Court of the United States
place: Supreme Court Building, Washington, D.C., United States
